title: 1-to-8 demultiplexer (per-bit with...select + after 20 ns)
problemDescription: 1-to-8 demux: y(sel) <= x; other outputs '0'. Bits 0 and 1 carry a 20 ns inertial/transport delay; bits 2-7 are instantaneous. Exercises both per-bit with…select (bug #5/#9 path) and `after N ns` (bug #8 path) at the same time.
